recognize_zh: 病灶大部分被寬大、互相吻合的嗜伊紅性玻璃樣小樑取代，小樑之間夾著小淋巴球與漿細胞；這些小樑可能是化骨／類骨質，但此圖看不到明確的骨小腔、造骨細胞邊緣或黏合線，也可能是玻璃樣化膠原，需高倍確認。
features: Broad, anastomosing, eosinophilic homogeneous trabeculae occupying much of the field
Trabeculae contain few cells; definite osteocytic lacunae, osteoblastic rimming or cement lines are not clearly resolved
Intervening spaces filled by small lymphocytes with admixed plasma cells and thin-walled vessels
No lymphoid follicles in this field
describe_en: Section shows a lesion extensively replaced by broad, anastomosing, eosinophilic trabeculae with intervening small lymphocytes, plasma cells and thin-walled vessels, and a focus of hemorrhage. The trabecular material is consistent with metaplastic ossification or osteoid, as described, but osteocytic lacunae, osteoblastic rimming and cement lines are not clearly evident at this magnification, so dense hyalinized collagen cannot be excluded from this image alone. No lymphoid follicles are present in this field. Findings are compatible with regressive stromal change (ossification/hyalinization) in long-standing Castleman disease, correlating with other fields showing regressed follicles.

ddx.vs: Hyalinized collagen lacks osteocytes in lacunae, osteoblast rimming and cement lines, which would need higher power or polarization to separate from bone.
Amyloid forms amorphous pale eosinophilic deposits, often perivascular, that are Congo red-positive with apple-green birefringence rather than trabecular bone.
Would contain atypical malignant cells producing osteoid, whereas the cells between trabeculae here are bland small lymphocytes and plasma cells.
